question: Your smart bedroom light suddenly turns on at full brightness after a brief midnight power outage. What setting prevents this?
explanation: Smart bulbs usually default to turning on at 100% brightness when power is restored so they work like traditional switches. In your smart home app, changing the light's power-on behavior to 'Last Status' or 'Off' prevents unexpected wake-up calls after sudden power cuts.
practical_challenge: Open your smart home app, select a smart light, and check its power restoration settings.
bonus_challenge: Set a smart bulb's power-on state to off and test it by toggling its wall switch.
